entries.title: SQLite WAL
entries.version_context: Current official page, last updated 2026-08-25; build-dependent
entries.independent_observation: One local writer; same-host WAL; persistent sidecar; reader end marks and reader gaps; commit durability differs by synchronous mode. Reset race: likely affected 3.7.0–3.51.2, fixed 3.51.3+, backports 3.44.6/3.50.7. Condition: concurrent connections in separate threads/processes writing/checkpointing.
entries.limits: Finite source inspection; no product execution or compatibility proof.

entries.title: SQLite synchronous
entries.independent_observation: WAL FULL syncs each commit; WAL NORMAL remains consistent but can lose a recent commit after system/power failure. Rollback FULL/EXTRA have distinct durability conditions; VFS/storage assumptions still apply.
entries.limits: Finite source inspection; no product execution or compatibility proof.

entries.title: SQLite Session introduction
entries.independent_observation: Compile-time enablement; declared PK and compatible schema/baseline; NULL PK rows omitted; stat1/API exceptions need care. Repeated row changes coalesce and reversions can disappear. Not an immutable per-action history.
entries.limits: Finite source inspection; no product execution or compatibility proof.

entries.title: SQLite Session API
entries.version_context: Current reference; some rebase/apply APIs experimental
entries.independent_observation: OMIT/REPLACE/ABORT have conflict-specific scope. Patchsets omit old non-key values and cannot report DATA conflicts; consumer supplies policy. This supports a conditional delta helper, not semantic conflict resolution.
entries.limits: Finite source inspection; no product execution or compatibility proof.

entries.title: SQLite Online Backup
entries.independent_observation: Completed backup is coherent; concurrent external source writes can restart incremental work. Main-file-only live WAL copy omits state; external-copy interruption can damage destination. Snapshot is not replica merge.
entries.limits: Finite source inspection; no product execution or compatibility proof.

entries.title: SQLite atomic commit
entries.version_context: Current technical article; detailed walkthrough is rollback mode
entries.independent_observation: Single DB atomic commit assumes working locks and sync/flush. Modified I/O crash tests check before/after recovery. File placement and a separate journal are separate commit domains.
entries.limits: Finite source inspection; no product execution or compatibility proof.

entries.independent_observation: Interrupted-state sidecars must accompany the database; active raw copy and broken filesystem locks can cause loss/corruption. Does not establish photo/DB atomicity.

entries.independent_observation: Default GET gives one winner; conflicts=true adds revision IDs; rev-specific GET or open_revs obtains bodies. Compaction drops non-leaf bodies, not all current conflict leaves. Explicit historical revision requests can be missing.
